routing.mask: unavailable; pinned node has no mask input or mask route
routing.attribute_process: controls array processing, not an Active flag
routing.outer_processor_arrays: unprocessed and unsupported by this explicit native profile
routing.scalar_execution: executes when attribute_process is false and still uses fixed RGBA8 output

neighbor_kernel.weight: exp(-5 * dot(g - fract(uv) + hash4(floor(uv) + g).xy, same))

source_shader_behavior.randomness: raw scalar blend passed to the shader; source node declares no clamp
source_shader_behavior.output: mix(weighted sample mean, variance-adjusted color using mean 0.3, randomness) multiplied by vertex color

native_profile.profile_selection: bounded native CPU arithmetic; no matched GPU arithmetic claim
native_profile.coordinates: stretched draw uses vTex=(pixel+0.5)/raw_dimension, then scales by raw_dimension/input_physical_dimensions; clip pixel centers to the raw-dimension rectangle

work_cap.accounting: all nine taps plus math and validation cost are charged before output allocation
work_cap.status: validated aggregate admission before output allocation

limitations: Atlas texture binding and unlinked Mask dimensions explicitly refuse execution.
With array processing disabled, scalar inputs still execute; unprocessed outer arrays explicitly refuse.
A licensed reference executable, matched GPU arithmetic and nondefault source draw-state captures remain unavailable.
